Common.OperationTimedOut: The operation timed out. Please try again.
Gathering.AutoEnableIslandSanctuaryGathe: Auto Enable Island Sanctuary Gather Mode
Gathering.AutomaticMovementHelp: Selects walking, riding, or flight using the total vnavmesh path length (default mount/flight thresholds: 20/40 yalms). Underwater movement uses the mount threshold. Each leg keeps its chosen mode; mounting or takeoff failure falls back to swimming, walking, or ground riding.
Gathering.ExecuteFromHereLoop: Execute route starting from this step and then loop
Gathering.ExecuteFromHereOnce: Execute route once starting from this step
Gathering.GatherModeHelp: Enables "Gather Mode" when on your Island Sanctuary automatically when commencing a route.
Gathering.GroundShortcutsHelp: Try direct ground movement within 12 yalms after collision and ground checks. Allows up to 1 yalm uphill or 3 yalms downhill, with limited steps. If blocked, try one jump on foot, then fall back to vnavmesh. Mounted movement does not jump to avoid taking off. Each attempt lasts at most 6 seconds.
Gathering.IslandOnlyHelp: Gathering routes are available only inside Island Sanctuary.
Gathering.IslandRouteRequired: Gathering routes can only run inside Island Sanctuary and cannot contain waypoints in other territories.
Gathering.LandingFailed: Landing attempts exhausted or timed out. Gathering has stopped.
Gathering.Name: Name:
Gathering.NavigationRetryHelp: Maximum recalculations per waypoint after getting stuck or navigation failing to start. Default: 3. After retries fail, try a different movement path via nearby intermediate points to the same waypoint. The gathering route and target stay unchanged. Stop if no usable detour remains. 0 tries detours immediately.
Gathering.NavmeshRequired: Automatic navigation requires vnavmesh. Please install and enable it.
Gathering.NoDetourAvailable: No alternative movement path is available. Gathering has stopped at the current waypoint.
Gathering.NodeMaterialsFull: Gathering stopped: all unlocked materials at the current node are at capacity.
Gathering.PreserveWaypointOrderHelp: Gathering points keep their saved order. Navigation only optimizes movement between consecutive waypoints.
Gathering.RapidImportHelp: Import multiple presets with ease by simply copying them. Visland will read your clipboard and attempt to import whatever you copy. Your clipboard will be cleared upon enabling.
Gathering.StopOnInventoryFullHelp: Stop only when every material currently unlocked for this gathering node is at its carrying limit. Materials locked by island progression or uncrafted tools are excluded. Continue if any available material has room. Unknown nodes do not trigger a stop.
Gathering.StuckDetectionHelp: After this many seconds without movement, try jumping while navigation continues. If horizontal movement stays below 0.5 yalms for 3 seconds, recalculate the path and use detours after the retry limit. Default: 10 seconds; 0 disables detection. Pauses, gathering and mounting do not count.
Gathering.TryingDetour: Navigation retries exhausted. Trying an alternative movement path to the same waypoint.
Granary.ReassignBothToLowestStock: Max out and select expedition bringing rare resource with lowest count in both granaries
Granary.ReassignToTwoLowestStocks: Max out and select expedition bringing rare resources with two lowest counts
Workshop.AdvancedFavourHelp: Shows manual favour-solver / clipboard override buttons on the Schedule tab.
Workshop.AutoLoadArchive: Automatically load archive recs on open
Workshop.AutoSelectNextCycle: Automatically select next cycle on open
Workshop.ClipboardImportHelp:
Legacy importer for schedules copied from Discord.
The importer detects item names (without "Isleworks" et al) on each line.
You can copy an entire workshop schedule from discord, junk included.
Workshop.FavourModeFreeRestDay: MinMax but use the second rest day for most of the favours
Workshop.FavourModeMinMax: Try to keep high-value crafts, try same-duration substitutions, sacrifice lowest-value days/workshops
Workshop.FavourRecipeUnavailable: A favour recipe is not unlocked for the current character.
Workshop.LoadArchiveHelp: Loads Overseas Casuals archive recommendations for the mapped season, then applies the favour mode from Settings.
Workshop.ManualOverrideHelp: Manual overrides for the currently loaded schedule. Archive loads already apply the favour mode from Settings.
Workshop.RecipePlanningUnavailable: Unable to build a full 24-hour schedule. Open the workshop on your island and check unlocked recipes.
Workshop.UnlockedSchedulesRebuilt: Recalculated {0} workshop schedule(s) using unlocked recipes; each fills 24 hours.
